cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)

set(MOD_ID "cinema-lite")
set(MOD_VERSION "0.1.0")
project(${MOD_ID})

add_library(${MOD_ID} SHARED main.cpp)
target_compile_definitions(${MOD_ID} PRIVATE
    MOD_ID="${MOD_ID}" VERSION="${MOD_VERSION}" FMT_HEADER_ONLY)
target_compile_options(${MOD_ID} PRIVATE -Wno-invalid-offsetof -Wno-deprecated-declarations)
target_include_directories(${MOD_ID} PRIVATE .)

# generated by `qpm restore`
include(extern.cmake)
target_link_libraries(${MOD_ID} PRIVATE -llog)
